prompts.name: base-front
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game art: an ORIGINAL hand-painted fantasy 2D cutout character sprite PARTS ATLAS for Elyndra, warm charming chibi JRPG adventurer, painterly polish like premium illustrated MMORPG sprites. Not flat vector, not photoreal or 3D.
Transparent PNG, wide 2:1 image, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows, 8 cells, no visible grid, no labels, no shadows, no backdrop. ONE isolated part centered in each cell with generous transparent margins. All parts seen directly from FRONT at eye level. They must belong to ONE identical character: youthful adult wayfarer, tousled chestnut short hair, warm amber eyes, tan skin, cream linen tunic with brown leather belt and bronze gear buckle, navy slate trousers, simple brown strapped sandals. Head large chibi, body about 2.8 heads tall assembled. Crisp dark-brown contours, soft painted shading, clearly readable at small game size. No floating sparkles or additional accessories.
Cell order, left to right:
TOP ROW:
1 complete head with hair, ears and short neck ONLY; beautiful expressive amber eyes, gentle confident smile, windswept chestnut hair, FRONT face.
2 torso ONLY from neckline to hips, cream linen tunic, small V neckline, leather waist belt with bronze gear clasp; NO head, NO arms, NO legs.
3 entire character's RIGHT arm (screen-left arm), cream short sleeve at top, bare forearm and loosely closed hand at bottom, hanging vertically straight. Shoulder top rounded and fully painted with overlap for joint.
4 entire character's LEFT arm (screen-right arm), mirrored pose matching other arm, same painted sleeve and hand. Hanging vertically.
BOTTOM ROW:
1 character's RIGHT upper leg ONLY, navy cloth thigh from rounded hip to rounded knee; straight down; no boot, no foot.
2 character's LEFT upper leg ONLY, matching navy thigh, straight down; no boot, no foot.
3 character's RIGHT lower leg ONLY from rounded knee to brown sandal-clad foot, navy trouser cuff, front view foot toward viewer. Knee at top and sole horizontal bottom. NO thigh.
4 character's LEFT lower leg ONLY matching, front view foot toward viewer.
Each part fully isolated, intact with smooth rounded overlapping joint ends. Important: do NOT draw complete characters; this is exactly 8 disjoint component illustrations for a skeletal paper doll. Center and enlarge each individual part within its own cell for high detail; head and torso are wider, arms and leg parts are narrow and vertical. Strictly no outlines of missing body parts.

prompts.name: equipment-front
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. EQUIPMENT PARTS sprite atlas for the exact chibi Wayfarer in reference image. Match premium warm hand-painted fantasy MMORPG illustration, dark warm contours and soft material shading. Transparent PNG SQUARE 1536x1536 or larger. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equally sized cells with generous transparent margins. One isolated equipment part centered in every cell, no labels, no grid, no ground shadows. Direct FRONT view. Items are empty clothing overlays, NO heads, bodies, hands or skin. Scale each part individually to fit its cell; runtime assembles them.
ROW 1:
1 Traveler Boot RIGHT foot (screen left), brown leather mid-calf boot, moss-green padded cuff, crossed laces, broad sole, front view toe pointing viewer.
2 matching Traveler Boot LEFT foot (screen right).
3 Leafweave Coat TORSO ONLY, sleeveless fitted green cloth from neck to upper hips, leaf vein embroidery, narrow warm bronze piping, brown belt with small brass leaf clasp. Open neck, no arms, NO cape, NO head. Shaped to cover reference cream torso.
ROW 2:
1 Leafweave Coat RIGHT SLEEVE ONLY, rounded shoulder cap at TOP to elbow at BOTTOM, empty green elbow-length sleeve matching coat. No hand, no forearm, no torso.
2 matching LEFT SLEEVE ONLY.
3 Leafweave Coat SHORT CAPE ONLY, dark forest-green back panel, bronze hem and subtle woven leaf pattern, broad shoulders at top, gently flared hem at knee; shown as complete flat outward-facing cape panel, no body.
ROW 3:
1 Copper Saber: short curved silver-grey blade with bronze copper gear-shaped guard and brown grip. FULL weapon isolated. Grip at UPPER RIGHT, blade points diagonally DOWN LEFT at 35 degrees below horizontal, no hands, no sparkle.
2 Surveyor Bow: upright briar wood bow warm reddish brown with ivory string; curved wooden limb on LEFT, taut straight string on RIGHT, center leather grip; no arrow, no hand.
3 Aether Rod: upright full-length staff, teal-blue scaled shaft with brass collars, large glowing teal crystalline finial held in brass leaves; grip in lower-middle; no floating magic or glow outside the crystal silhouette.
Same materials and visual scale family as reference. Each of NINE parts completely isolated in its own cell. Absolutely no assembled human characters.

Row 1: RIGHT boot profile pointing LEFT; LEFT boot profile pointing LEFT; green coat TORSO ONLY in strict side view facing LEFT (neck to hips, no sleeve, no cape or body).
Row 2: near coat SLEEVE ONLY, rounded shoulder at top, elbow opening bottom; far matching sleeve ONLY; complete short green CAPE ONLY hanging vertically in SIDE PROFILE, narrow shoulder attachment at top and draping backward toward RIGHT lower hem. No human parts in clothing.
Row 3: silver Copper Saber with bronze gear guard, grip upper right and blade down left; upright Surveyor Bow with reddish wood curved limb to LEFT and ivory taut string to RIGHT, no arrow; upright teal scaled Aether Rod with bronze collars and teal crystal at top.
The last three weapons keep recognizable broad-side silhouettes for 2D readability. All are beautiful hand-painted chibi fantasy game components, not flat diagrams. Boots must clearly point to LEFT, torso shown from left side. Exactly nine components, no complete characters.

prompts.name: base-joint-correction-all-views
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the trouser joint caps in the BOTTOM ROW of this transparent 8-part character sprite atlas. The peach/tan skin-coloured ovals at TOP and BOTTOM of the two thigh components and TOP of the two lower-leg components are WRONG. Replace ALL these peach ovals at trouser joint ends with fully opaque NAVY BLUE TROUSER FABRIC matching adjacent cloth. Each thigh is completely covered by navy fabric from rounded top to rounded bottom; each shin begins with a rounded navy fabric cap. No exposed knees, no exposed skin inside trousers. Preserve legitimate skin of toes inside sandals and all arms/face in TOP ROW. Keep every part in EXACT same cell, same silhouette dimensions, pose, identity, color, detail, lighting and transparency. Do not rearrange or add anything. No lines, labels or background. ONLY replace trouser joint skin caps with matching navy fabric.
